description: The 20 March FESEN/CSTB sit-in is documented by one opened report, but no attendance number or estimate establishes the required 50-person threshold. Candidate benin_2024-03_E001 therefore remains pending_threshold.
required_followup: Seek independent contemporary attendance evidence or an attributable observer estimate.

description: A separate captured announcement describes an AME sit-in on 20 March at the ministry. Its relation to the FESEN/CSTB sit-in is unresolved. The CSTB account also references earlier AME mobilization and March 18 government measures, but does not establish a continuous protest episode into this event.
required_followup: Establish whether the announcements concern one gathering or distinct groups/actions, and whether any earlier AME action physically continued into March 20.

description: The opened report gives no physical end time/date and no event-specific state response to the 20 March sit-in. It recounts government silence and disciplinary letters after the separate 7 March strike; those are not coded as response to the sit-in.
required_followup: Seek event-specific reporting on the gathering’s end and any state response.

description: The Le Matinal account includes a reproduced FESEN/CSTB declaration. The second opened Le Matinal article reproduces CSTB material; these are not independent corroboration. Other captured March strike/sit-in excerpts may repeat union statements and were not opened.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporary report or original documentation that does not merely reproduce the same union statement.

description: Bounded open-web discovery in French and English included broad monthly, weekly, regional/place and sector searches. Result-date filtering was unreliable and source discovery is not exhaustive.
required_followup: Compare the captured lead inventory with systematic local press archives and the official baseline.
